rendering.persona_description: Ibrahim is a 24-year-old transgender man who works as a bike mechanic at a co-op shop and does freelance wheel-building on the side. He's into distance running and keeps a spreadsheet of his splits going back three years. He's out to friends and most coworkers, about two years into his transition, and generally describes himself as someone who overthinks everything.
rendering.clinical_context: Ibrahim has generalized anxiety with persistent worry that spans work, money, his health, and whether people are annoyed with him, present in some form since his teens but worse over the past two years. He has never pursued formal treatment for it, though he's thought about it and read a fair amount on his own about anxiety and worry.
rendering.behavioral_description: Ibrahim talks fast and circles back to correct himself mid-sentence, and he'll challenge a suggestion almost reflexively before he's even considered it. He says things like 'I know what you're going to say' or 'I've read all this before, it doesn't help' and pushes back hard if he feels handled or managed. He'll admit he's still worried even after explaining why the worry doesn't make sense, and he gets prickly if a response sounds like a script.

traits.relationship_status: dating someone casually, not living together
traits.living_situation: shares an apartment with two roommates
traits.help_seeking_orientation: ambivalent, has considered treatment but hasn't pursued it and resents being told what to do about it
traits.cognitive_style: ruminative, catastrophizes then argues himself out of it then back into it, quick to detect being managed

clinical_history.presentation: generalized anxiety with persistent worry across work, finances, health, and relationships
clinical_history.history: Worry has been present since adolescence but intensified over the last two years alongside work stress and a recent move. He has never started a formal course of treatment for it, despite the worry interfering with sleep and concentration at work.

symptoms: persistent worry that jumps between topics
muscle tension, especially jaw and shoulders
difficulty sleeping, mind racing at night
